rationale: Declaration of local-only scope; not a dynamic application test
No network dependency is allowed in the proposed scope
Exact anonymous-field allowlist; no personal identifiers
Operating model must use the current prototype interface
Short bounded retention in the closed rehearsal
All three distinct handoff roles are required
A concrete stop/escalation instruction must exist
Operator kit cannot refer to an obsolete interface
At least four unique nonempty operator steps
Closed exercise is not a public launch
Content pass is not use or publication authority
The kit must visibly disclose the fictional exercise
The derived report requires every upstream content gate
